title: MCP server
statement: The system shall run a stdio MCP server exposing the store, analysis, changeset, project and verification tools to agents.
rationale: Reverse-engineered from the implemented reqforge 0.2 behaviour.

acceptance_criteria.text: initialize, tools/list and tools/call follow JSON-RPC 2.0 and MCP, with protocol errors for unknown methods
Project tools are exposed and project deletion is not
